description: Get the whole-market derivatives board in one call: total open interest with its crypto-versus-RWA split (the headline includes RWA perps: equities, commodities, ETFs, indices, FX), 24h liquidations on Binance, Bybit and Deribit only (a lower bound, not the market total: OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, Bitget and other venues are not in it), average Wilder RSI(14) across the top 100 crypto perps by market cap, the Altcoin Season Index (share of the top 50 by market cap beating BTC over 90 days, excluding stablecoins and wrapped/staked derivatives), open interest broken down by asset class, and a ranked per-asset row table. The tab parameter selects the universe: crypto, equity, preipo, etf, index, commodity or fx. Rows carry price, 24h return, funding rate (interval-true, never assumed 8h), 24h volume, market cap, open interest with 1h and 24h changes (returns and changes are fractions: 0.01 is 1%), plus liquidations on crypto or a venue count on RWA tabs. Ranks are by open interest descending. Liquidations are crypto-only because no RWA venue publishes a liquidation feed. Use this for 'what is the market doing' questions; use get_funding_rates for per-venue crypto funding detail and get_rwa_perp_funding for RWA carry and cross-venue spreads.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum rows per page (1-1000). Enables cursor pagination.

tab.description: Universe to return rows for. The metric block is identical on every tab.

name: get_global_overview

fundingRate.description: Funding fraction normalized to an 8h basis; never assumes the venue interval. Crypto tab: the coin's average across venues (the funding grid's Avg Rate), each venue's primary contract weighted by its one-sided open interest when at least two venues, and a majority of them, carry open interest, otherwise their median; only venues refreshed within 10 minutes; null when there is none. RWA tabs: the open-interest-weighted mean across RWA venues (the plain mean when none carries open interest) of the rates a trader can compare: a non-zero rate, or 0 while the underlying's home market is open on a market that has funded, from a venue refreshed within the hour; null when there is none, so a venue's 0 outside its home market's hours is not averaged in.

liquidations24hUsd.description: Crypto tab only: 24h liquidations on Binance and Bybit (our own capture of their liquidation streams) and Deribit (Velo), not every venue behind openInterestUsd. OKX is left out: its series is a delayed, partial sample of OKX's liquidations, not their total. Null for coins the futures sync does not track and on RWA tabs, where no venue publishes a liquidation feed.

marketCapUsd.description: Crypto tab: CoinGecko market cap, top 100 coins by market cap only (null below). Null on every RWA tab (no RWA market-cap source), including preipo and index, where no market cap exists.

price.description: Crypto tab: the freshest of the coin's 1h futures candle close, its Binance mark from the funding book (5-minute refresh), the CoinGecko price (3-hourly) and the last daily close; null when the coin has none of them. RWA tabs: the open-interest-weighted mean of the venues' marks (price-suspect venues left out; the plain mean when no venue carries open interest).

return24h.description: The 24h price return, a fraction (0.01 is 1%). Crypto tab: from the 1h futures candles (about 100 coins the futures sync tracks), else CoinGecko's 24h change (top 100 by market cap); null for most of the long tail.

venueCount.description: Venues behind openInterestUsd: on the crypto tab the distinct venues holding the asset's contracts (lot and quote spellings count once per venue); on RWA tabs how many venues list the underlying.

volume24hUsd.description: Crypto tab: 24h futures notional from the 1h candles, which cover only the ~100 coins the futures sync tracks, so most crypto rows are null (not measured, never spot volume).

OpenInterestExclusion.description: A venue whose stored open interest is published per venue but left out of every cross-venue total, and why. MEXC and BingX today: MEXC's holdVol moves 7.00x the position change of its own deal feed, so it fits neither side count; BingX's figure moved faster than its own trades allow and is no longer read, so only its stored history remains.

altcoinSeasonIndex.description: Share of the top 50 by market cap beating BTC over 90 days; excludes stablecoins and wrapped/staked derivatives.

avgRsi.description: Unweighted mean Wilder RSI(14) on daily closes, top 100 crypto perps by market cap.

liquidations24hUsd.description: Crypto only, and a lower bound rather than a market-wide total: liquidations for three venues (Binance and Bybit from our own capture, Deribit from Velo) over the coins the futures sync tracks (~85 rows carry one), summed over hourly buckets in a rolling 23-24h window, newest bucket still accumulating. OKX is not included (its series is a delayed, partial sample of OKX's liquidations, not their total), and neither are the other venues behind openInterestUsd (Hyperliquid, Gate, Bitget, ...).

liquidationsHistory.description: The last 30 complete UTC days, oldest first: each day's liquidations on Binance, Bybit and Deribit, by side. Null when the history store could not be read.

liquidationsLongUsd.description: Long side of the 24h liquidation total, so a cascade reads as flushed longs or shorts. Crypto only.

liquidationsShortUsd.description: Short side of the 24h liquidation total. Crypto only.

openInterestExcludedVenues.description: Venues whose open interest every figure on the board leaves out, with the reason.

openInterestHistory.description: The last 30 complete UTC days, oldest first: market open interest at each day's close (the day in progress is the live headline). Null when the history store could not be read.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Global market overview
